strategy: Every niche must be (a) generatable purely by an AI and (b) executable by an AI agent autonomously (no physical presence, no human body). Diversified across 6 baskets so income streams don't correlate.

niches.name: AI SEO Affiliate in Boring Niches
niches.problem: Buyers search boring high-intent keywords (plumbing parts, medical supplies, industrial tools) but the content is thin and outdated.
niches.audience: You (autonomous operator); readers with clear buying intent.
niches.offer: AI writes + edits 50-100 niche reviews/articles per month, monetized via Amazon Associates / affiliate networks.
niches.ai_execution: AI researches keywords, writes+edits articles, publishes via the WordPress REST API, builds internal links, and monitors rankings. A fully autonomous content machine.
niches.pitch: A content machine in boring niches that earns while you sleep.

niches.name: Faceless YouTube with AI Narration
niches.problem: Creators want video income without showing their face or filming anything.
niches.audience: You (autonomous); viewers in evergreen niches (history, finance explainers, how-to).
niches.offer: AI generates the script, AI voice (ElevenLabs), and assembles footage/stock into daily shorts + longform, monetized via ads + sponsors.
niches.ai_execution: AI generates the script, renders voiceover, assembles the video, uploads via the YouTube Data API, and optimizes titles/thumbnails. An autonomous channel.
niches.pitch: A faceless channel that prints ad revenue on autopilot.

niches.name: Public-Domain Republishing
niches.problem: Thousands of books and artworks are free in the public domain but buried and poorly formatted.
niches.audience: Readers, teachers, and niche hobbyists wanting clean editions or merch.
niches.offer: AI curates + formats public-domain works into eBooks, print-on-demand, and licensed merch.
niches.competition: Low (most ignore the public domain entirely)
niches.ai_execution: AI fetches public-domain texts, cleans and formats them, generates covers, and publishes to KDP/Etsy via API. An autonomous catalog.
niches.pitch: Free raw material, formatted and sold forever.

niches.name: AI-Built Template Store
niches.problem: People want systems but cannot build them themselves.
niches.offer: AI designs Notion / Sheets / Airtable templates and sells them as digital products.
niches.ai_execution: AI designs the template, exports it, writes the sales copy, and lists it on Gumroad via API. An autonomous store.
niches.pitch: Templates that do the thinking so you can do the work.

niches.name: AI Resume & Cover Letter Rewrites
niches.problem: Job seekers get ignored by ATS systems and weak resumes.
niches.audience: Career changers, recent grads, laid-off professionals.
niches.offer: AI polishes the resume + cover letter via a prompt chain, plus a 30-min strategy call (you or AI-booked).
niches.ai_execution: AI ingests the client's resume, rewrites it through a prompt chain, delivers a .docx, and books the call via Cal.com. A human is needed only for optional final QA.
niches.pitch: Land more interviews in 7 days — AI-polished, human-approved.

niches.name: AI Voiceover & Dubbing Service
niches.problem: Creators need voiceovers/dubs but studios are expensive and slow.
niches.audience: YouTubers, course creators, indie game devs.
niches.offer: Natural AI voiceovers + multilingual dubbing for videos.
niches.ai_execution: AI ingests the script, generates the voice, edits, and delivers the file. Fully autonomous fulfillment.
niches.pitch: Studio-quality voice, same-day turnaround, fraction of the cost.

niches.name: AI Class-Action Claim Filing
niches.problem: People are owed settlement money but miss deadlines or don't know a case exists.
niches.audience: Consumers in active settlements, data-breach victims, investors.
niches.offer: AI curates open settlements, prepares and files the claim forms on the client's behalf for a cut.
niches.competition: Low (feels 'too good to be true' so few do it)
niches.ai_execution: AI scrapes open settlements, matches them to client data, autofills claim forms via browser automation, and tracks deadlines. An autonomous filing assistant.
niches.pitch: Money already awarded to you — we just file the paperwork.

niches.name: AI Warranty & Rebate Recovery
niches.problem: People overpay for repairs that were covered by warranty, or forget rebates they earned.
niches.audience: Busy homeowners, fleet owners, parents with many appliances.
niches.offer: AI audits past purchases, files the warranty claims / rebates the client forgot, and takes a percentage.
niches.ai_execution: AI ingests purchase history from statements, matches it against a warranty/rebate database, and files claims via portal automation. Autonomous recovery.
niches.pitch: We found €400 you already owned. Keep 80%, we take 20%.

niches.name: AI Retail/Online Arbitrage
niches.problem: Discounted retail goods sell for more on marketplaces; the grunt work filters out most people.
niches.offer: AI scans deals and resells genuine discounted goods on Amazon/bol.com (first-sale doctrine = legal).
niches.ai_execution: AI monitors deal feeds, scores margin after fees, and routes to fulfillment. A human ships/inspects optionally. An autonomous deal engine.
niches.pitch: Buy low, sell higher — the oldest quiet money, AI-scaled.

niches.name: AI Domain Flipping & Parking
niches.problem: Expired or underused domains have real value that most people ignore.
niches.offer: AI finds underpriced expiring domains, then holds them with parking ads or flips them.
niches.ai_execution: AI scans expiring domains for traffic/keywords, appraises them, bids via the registrar API, and parks them with ads. An autonomous portfolio.
niches.pitch: Digital land that nobody prices correctly.

niches.name: Boring Micro-SaaS (one person)
niches.problem: Solo firms need tiny automation (invoicing, cash-flow, tax reminders) that no giant tool covers.
niches.audience: Freelancers, small accounting practices, trades businesses.
niches.offer: A narrow $9-29/mo tool that solves one painful, frequent, measurable workflow.
niches.ai_execution: AI scopes the tool, builds the no-code app, writes the copy, sets up Stripe, and markets it via autoposts. An autonomous build + launch.
niches.pitch: One boring problem, solved forever, $9/month, compounding.

niches.name: AI Chatbot for Local Businesses
niches.problem: Local businesses lose leads after hours and on weekends.
niches.audience: Dentists, salons, plumbers, gyms in your city.
niches.offer: AI builds + hosts a no-code booking/FAQ chatbot with handover to the owner.
niches.ai_execution: AI scrapes local businesses, drafts outreach, builds the bot, deploys it, and handles onboarding via email automation. Semi-autonomous.
niches.pitch: Never miss a lead at midnight again — your 24/7 AI receptionist.
